description: NaV₃(SO₇)₂ crystallizes in the trigonal R32 space group. Na is bonded to twelve O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with six equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and faces with six equivalent VO₆ octahedra. There are six shorter (2.86 Å) and six longer (2.96 Å) Na-O bond lengths. V is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted VO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent VO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra, and faces with two equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 39°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.70-2.09 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra and corners with three equivalent VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 51°. There is one shorter (1.43 Å) and three longer (1.52 Å) S-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and two equivalent V atoms.
